QuestInfo.name: Shining Crescent Emblem
QuestInfo.0: Shingen has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Shingen has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.2: Shingen has given you an Emblem.

0.0: I've been waiting for you, #b#h0##k. Your commitment has been a shining example of the virtues a warrior should possess. Your bravery and heroic feats are respected by all.
0.1: This Emblem is for you and only you. This is proof that I acknowledge you as a mighty hero, and more importantly, a fierce friend. Take it.

no.0: This is for you and only you. I can't let you refuse it.

yes.0: Your sacrifices will be long-remembered by future generations. Never stray from your path as a true warrior!
